title: Parallelism, Concurrency, and Asynchrony in Perl 6 / Jonathan Worthington
summary: Jonathan Worthington's YAPC Asia 2015 talk on parallelism, concurrency and asynchrony in Perl 6. It covers the language's concurrency features.
why: HN commenters offer it as a good example of what Perl 6 does well and as a way to get started with the language.

quote.text: I recommend a look at a couple of videos to get started too
